recommended_additions.title: A life of finding her way back
copy: Déa grew up in Brazil, where she and her fraternal twin were adopted together as infants. Today, she is a mother of five and a grandmother. Her experience of divorce, faith and rebuilding her life shapes the way she connects with others.

A creative life brought her to the United States through dance scholarships at the Joffrey Ballet and Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater. She later became a singer, songwriter, entrepreneur and podcast host. Her work now centers on helping people reconnect with themselves and build healthier relationships.
recommended_additions.note: Paraphrased biographical facts; no invented first-person quotation.
